description: Source code implementing process and error pipe management for the 'angel' component of lighttpd, including pipe creation, reading, process forking, and cleanup.

methods.name: read_pipe
methods.description: Reads data from an error pipe, handles errors, and optionally flushes the pipe.

methods.name: error_pipe_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when data is available on the error pipe, reads data from the pipe.

methods.name: li_error_pipe_new
methods.description: Creates a new error pipe, initializes event watcher.

methods.name: li_error_pipe_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an error pipe.

methods.name: li_error_pipe_activate
methods.description: Activates the error pipe for output.

methods.name: li_error_pipe_use
methods.description: Redirects the error pipe's output to a specified file descriptor.

methods.name: li_error_pipe_flush
methods.description: Flushes the error pipe, reading remaining data.

methods.name: proc_epipe_cb
methods.description: Callback for processing error pipe messages, logs process info.

methods.name: li_proc_new
methods.description: Creates a new process, forks, sets resource limits, user/group IDs, and executes the specified command.

methods.name: li_proc_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a process.
